## Before You Go: Two Masses, One Movable Pulley

The hardest one yet — a movable pulley connecting two masses that both move, neither one held by a hand.

Submit your best answer first, then step through the complete solution one idea at a time.

**Same tools as always: isolate a system, write F = ma twice, then combine the equations with algebra — now with a length constraint too.**
